description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application demonstrating network connectivity and data fetching. It manages UI interactions, initiates network downloads through a fragment, and handles download callbacks.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An activity that manages network fetch operations, UI updates, and user interactions for fetching HTML content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and retrieves references to UI components and network fragment.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for user actions.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to initiate download or clear data.

methods.name: startDownload
methods.description: Starts the network download if not already in progress.

methods.name: updateFromDownload
methods.description: Updates the UI with the downloaded content or error message.

methods.name: finishDownloading
methods.description: Stops ongoing download and resets UI status.

methods.name: onProgressUpdate
methods.description: Handles progress updates during download, updating the UI accordingly.
